enemies.name: Goblin King
enemies.description: The Goblin King rises from his throne, twin axes glinting. "You should not have come here, fools."
enemies.successText: Your blow rocks the King — he staggers but holds his ground!
enemies.failText: The King counters with brutal speed — both axes find their mark.

enemies.name: Royal Guard
enemies.description: A royal guard charges at you with a barbed pike!
enemies.successText: You disarm and dispatch the guard!
enemies.failText: The pike scores a deep gash.

enemies.name: Royal Guard
enemies.description: A second guard rushes from the other side, snarling!
enemies.failText: Quick swipes — you take a beating.

challenges.name: Lyra's Cage
challenges.description: Lyra is locked in a goblin-iron cage beside the throne. The lock is crude but stubborn. "Hurry — pick it!"
challenges.successText: The lock clicks open. Lyra steps free, gasping in relief. "You came!"
challenges.failText: The lock jams. You scrape your knuckles on the rough iron — try again.
